name: Steel Nutz Metal Fabrication
old_description: At Steel Nutz Metal Fabrication, we are passionate about delivering high-quality custom metal fabrication solutions built to meet your exact needs. With extensive experience in custom fabrication, we specialize in custom off-road fabrication for all your off-road desert toys, creating durable, precision-built components designed to perform in the toughest conditions. We also design and fabricate custom trailers tailored to your specific hauling and recreational needs. Every project is completed with expert craftsmanship, attention to detail, and a commitment to quality, ensuring long-lasting results you can rely on. Whether you're upgrading your off-road vehicle, building a one-of-a-kind trailer, or need custom metal fabrication, Steel Nutz Metal Fabrication is dedicated to bringing your vision to life with precision, durability, and exceptional service.
about:
Steel Nutz Metal Fabrication operates from Murrieta, California. The shop is owned by Mike, who oversees a team that includes fabricators such as Reid, Cole, Justin, and Jeremy. The company’s founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides custom welding and commercial fabrication, with a focus on off-road vehicle components, custom trailers, suspension upgrades, work trucks, and exhaust systems. Projects range from small brackets to large structures such as a two-story steel bunker, though the facility size and annual volume are not specified.

Customers include contractors, business owners, and recreational enthusiasts. The company has built trailers for contractors, reinforced off-road vehicles for desert racing, repaired watercraft for a rental fleet, and upgraded suspension on sand cars and rock crawlers.

Steel Nutz emphasizes expert craftsmanship, attention to detail, and a commitment to quality on every job. The shop advertises free quotes and carries insurance, positioning itself as a partner that delivers precision and durability for demanding applications.
